P1: 11号道路 is a grassy path between 12号道路 and 枯叶市 to the west.

P2: The wild 卡比兽 is still sleeping on the east side of 枯叶市, blocking travel to and from 11号道路. It also happens to be blocking the western entrance to 地鼠洞穴. To wake it up, tune the Pokégear's radio to the upper-middle part of the grid, then examine the creature to place the device next to it. The 宝可梦之笛 music rouses the Pokémon from its nap, and it attacks in a grumpy rage!
P3: 地鼠洞穴 is a long tunnel that spans nearly the whole region, linking 枯叶市 to the east side of 2号道路. Like the name implies, the only native Pokémon that can be found here are 地鼠 and its evolved form, 三地鼠. With the 浅红市 beach blocked off, it is currently the only way to reach western Kanto.

P7: From the southern entrance, follow the trail to the northwest to reach a 叶之石 near a lone tree. Jump the ledge and return to the entrance, and this time head eastward. Pass by Bug Catcher Dane to reach 招式学习器77（自我暗示） on a patch of dirt nearby. Turn north and battle Bug Catcher Dion on the east side of the forest. Continue northward through the tall grass, or along the path to battle Bug Catcher Stacey. To the northwest, a 蓝色玻璃哨 can be found on a large dirt patch. Farther north, the path diverges; taking the eastern stairway leads to the forest's northeast corner, where Bug Catcher Ellis can be found running laps. Turn west and zigzag through the trees to find a 要害攻击 on the northernmost dirt patch. Explore the dead-end path to the southwest to get a 全复药, then continue northwestward. Pass by Bug Catcher Abner to reach the northern edge of the forest. Leave the gate to re-emerge on 2号道路 and continue north to 深灰市.
P8: 深灰市 is a quiet city nestled in the northern mountains between 2号道路 and 3号道路. The Pewter Museum of Science and the Pewter Gym are located here.

P9: Visit the Pokémon Center to find a man who would like to trade Pokémon. He is willing to part with his 天然鸟 in exchange for a 鬼斯通. Haunter can be found on 8号道路, while its previous form, 鬼斯, can be found in Johto's 喇叭芽之塔 and 铃铛塔.
P10: The Pewter Museum of Science is located on the north side of the city. It hosts a range of artifacts and exhibits, with a focus on fossils and other specimens from the Kanto region. The receptionist informs visitors that because the larger specimens have been loaned to other museums, admission is free of charge.
P11: One of the workers, a Super Nerd, can be found near the entrance. He mentions how several meteorites had once struck somewhere near 深灰市. The museum would be thrilled to have them on display here, but the meteorites are said to emit strange energy and cannot be carried away.
P12: In the smaller side room, another Super Nerd runs the fossil regeneration procedure. Speak to him to hand over one of the seven known types of fossil to be revived. The procedure takes a moment to complete, so leave the building and return a short time later to receive the ancient Pokémon.

C1:
Pewter City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Brock
The Rock Solid Pokémon Trainer
P20: The Pewter Gym specializes in 岩石 Pokémon. Rock-type moves are super effective against 虫-, 火-, 飞行-, and 冰 Pokémon, while Rock-type Pokémon are weak to 格斗-, 草-, 地面-, 钢-, and 水 moves.
P21: The Gym features a rock garden, and has only two optional Gym Trainer battles before reaching the Gym Leader.
P22: Because of their dual typings, each of Brock's five Pokémon take massive damage from 草 attacks. Aside from that, 水 moves are effective against his 隆隆石, 独角犀牛, and 大岩蛇. Brock likes to dig for fossils in 月见山 in his spare time, and has acquired two prehistoric Pokémon in 多刺菊石兽 and 镰刀盔. Both are vulnerable to 电 attacks, as well.
P23: After the battle, Brock awards you the 灰色徽章. He also hands out 招式学习器80（岩崩） as a prize.
P24: There is an elderly man standing on a hill on the east side of town. Speak to him, and he reminisces about training in Johto as a young man. Something about you reminds him of his younger self, and he is happy to give you a treasure that he found there all those years ago: the Silver Wing / Rainbow Wing. This shimmering feather lets you track down the second of Johto's two legendary birds.
